findings.title: Actual point-charge comparison circle must be dashed
findings.evidence: All three viewed PNGs show a solid continuous contour. Read-only inspection of the matching SVG ellipse ld-fig-126_ld-f126-dashed-reference-circle shows no stroke-dasharray attribute/style. The current full spec nevertheless declares dash2 on that circle.
findings.impact: The actual output removes the original solid conducting-sphere versus dashed comparison-radius distinction. It can suggest a second physical charged-sphere boundary and contradicts the declared figure construction.
findings.requestedAffectedOnlyRepair: Make the actual fig126 reference contour visibly dashed via the producer's authorized rendering route. Preserve center/radius, twelve outward rays, the radius indicator and English/math labels. Keep fig125 and fig127 PASS and all passed text; do not reopen source images or hand-edit generated SVG.
